title: One-pot catalytic oxidation for the synthesis of 2-biphenylbenzoxazoles, benzothiazoles and 1-substituted benzimidazoles: a convenient and efficient strategy
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3527-3533
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08212A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yifan Ouyang, Niuniu Zhang, Mingkang Yang, Hao Yang, Bei Jiang, Huilong Xie, Meimei Zhang
We report a one-pot, catalytic oxidative synthesis of 2-biphenylbenzoxazoles, benzothiazoles and 1-substituted benzimidazoles from 2-aminosubstituted phenols/thiophenols/phenylamines and substituted biphenylcarbaldehydes.
